│             │ │ make_local_attention_virtual_batches_original… │
│             │ │ attn_chunk_size: int,\n    query_start_loc_np: │

│             │ │ not in the first local attention block and\n   │
│             │ │ #  then we can simply use a cdiv for the       │

│             │ │ #\n    # First Get batched arange. (E.g., [2,  │

│             │ │ (TODO: max a utility to share this code with   │

│             │ │ arange (i.e. [1, 0, 3, 2, 1, 0, 1, 0])\n       │
│             │ │ rarange = np.repeat(local_blocks,              │
│             │ │ local_blocks) - arange - 1\n    # Then we can  │
│             │ │ compute the seqlens_q_local, handling the fact │
│             │ │ that the\n    #  first and last blocks could   │
│             │ │ be partial\n    seqlens_q_local =              │

│             │ │ local_blocks)\n    # set the first block since │
│             │ │ this may be a partial block\n                  │
